scope: Upcoming UK and Ireland event locations. Location labels describe the recorded locality/start venue, not every county traversed by a route. Exact OS locality enrichment is distinct from fresh event-venue verification. England uses ceremonial counties; Scotland council areas; Wales principal areas; Ireland traditional counties and provinces. No guessed geography.

sources.note: Schedule 1 table read; Stockton-on-Tees excluded because its county depends on bank of River Tees.
Tourism Ireland explicit county lists under Connacht, Ulster, Munster and Leinster; province does not replace country.
